propositions: _assignee_resolver is injected as an attribute on OutboundMapper via side-channel, discovered via getattr with silent fallback to non-authoritative resolution
attribute injection fails silently when assignment is blocked, causing permanent non-authoritative assignee resolution and diff churn
Data Center adapter copied the getattr pattern into a class where the attribute was never set, creating dead code in the authoritative branch
resolver dependency is invisible to type checker and requires type: ignore[attr-defined] comments at injection sites
explicit parameter passing on OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee contract makes the dependency typed and prevents silent failures
resolver must be threaded through compute_update_fields to diff_canonical_fields to reach the resolve_assignee call site
